rows.commentary: 0.1: Muzahir Raza launches into the attack, and Khawaja Nafay immediately deposits him over deep mid-wicket for a massive six.
0.2: Muzahir Raza adjusts his length, allowing Khawaja Nafay to steer a single out toward deep extra cover.
0.3: Dot ball from Muzahir Raza to Abbas Afridi.
0.4: Wide from Muzahir Raza to Abbas Afridi.
0.4: Muzahir Raza angles it into Abbas Afridi, who pushes the ball firmly toward sweeper cover for a single.
0.5: Muzahir Raza strikes as Khawaja Nafay skies one out to Aamir Kaleem, departing for 7 off 3 balls after hitting a maximum.
0.6: Muzahir Raza strays in his line again, and Abdul Samad punishes him with a colossal six soaring toward deep mid-wicket.
1.1: Shafiq Jan bowls a wide to Abbas Afridi.
1.1: Shafiq Jan enters the attack and gets greeted brutally by Abbas Afridi, who launches it straight down the ground for a maximum.
1.2: Shafiq Jan offers width, and Abbas Afridi dispatches it effortlessly to the sweeper cover boundary for six more.
3.4: Muhammad Shahzad delivers and Zohaib Amanat swats it effortlessly over fine leg for six.
3.5: Leg byes off Muhammad Shahzad's delivery to Zohaib Amanat, 4 runs in all.
3.6: Muhammad Shahzad pitches it up and Zohaib Amanat launches it cleanly over deep extra cover for six.
4.1: Ahmed Daniyal collects and catches Aamir Kaleem short of his ground for a golden duck via a run out.
4.2: Ahmed Daniyal keeps it tight as Zohaib Amanat drives firmly toward extra cover for a single.
4.3: Usman Ali Afridi does not score off Ahmed Daniyal.
4.4: Ahmed Daniyal drops one in and Usman Ali Afridi pushes it down to long-on to rotate the strike.
4.5: Ahmed Daniyal strays in line and Zohaib Amanat sweeps it fiercely away to backward square leg for four.
4.6: Dot ball from Ahmed Daniyal to Zohaib Amanat.
5.1: Irfan Khan is greeted rudely by Usman Ali Afridi who lofts him majestically over deep extra cover for six.
5.2: Irfan Khan loops it up again and Usman Ali Afridi dispatches it once more over deep extra cover for six.
5.3: Irfan Khan shortens the length and Usman Ali Afridi collects a comfortable single out toward long-on.
5.4: Irfan Khan overpitches and Zohaib Amanat detonates it straight down the ground for a massive six.
5.5: Irfan Khan feels the pressure as Zohaib Amanat pulls him emphatically to deep mid-wicket for six.
5.6: Irfan Khan finishes the over poorly as Zohaib Amanat slices an incredible six away to deep backward point.
